class.name: ShaderMaterial
class.brief_description: A material defined by a custom [Shader] program and the values of its shader parameters.
class.description: A material that uses a custom [Shader] program to render visual items (canvas items, meshes, skies, fog), or to process particles. Compared to other materials, [ShaderMaterial] gives deeper control over the generated shader code. For more information, see the shaders documentation index below. Multiple [ShaderMaterial]s can use the same shader and configure different values for the shader uniforms. [b]Note:[/b] For performance reasons, the [signal Resource.changed] signal is only emitted when the [member Resource.resource_name] changes. Only in editor, it is also emitted for [member shader] changes.

method.name: get_shader_feature
method.description: Returns the current value of the named shader [param feature]. This is like a boolean uniform, but is static rather than being a uniform, causing it to change how the shader compiles.

method.name: get_shader_parameter
method.description: Returns the current value of a uniform from the shader, which has been set for this material.

method.name: get_shader_variant
method.description: Returns the index of the actively selected [param variant] with the provided name. This is like an enum uniform, but is static rather than being a uniform, causing it to change how the shader compiles.

method.name: get_shader_variant_index
method.description: Provided with the name of a shader [param variant], and the name of one of its allowed options, this returns the numeric index of that option.

method.name: is_valid_shader_feature
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the provided [param feature] name is one that has been registered to this material.

method.name: is_valid_shader_variant_key
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the provided [param variant] name is one that has been registered to this material.

method.name: is_valid_shader_variant_value
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the provided [param variant] name is one that has been registered to this material, and if the provided [param index] is the name of a valid value for said variant.

method.name: set_shader_feature
method.description: Sets the value of the provided shader [param feature]. This is like a boolean uniform, but is static rather than being a uniform, causing it to change how the shader compiles.

method.name: set_shader_parameter
method.description: Changes the value set for this material of a uniform in the shader. [b]Note:[/b] [param param] is case-sensitive and must match the name of the uniform in the code exactly (not the capitalized name in the inspector). [b]Note:[/b] Changes to the shader uniform will be effective on all instances using this [ShaderMaterial]. To prevent this, use per-instance uniforms with [method CanvasItem.set_instance_shader_parameter], [method GeometryInstance3D.set_instance_shader_parameter] or duplicate the [ShaderMaterial] resource using [method Resource.duplicate]. Per-instance uniforms allow for better shader reuse and are therefore faster, so they should be preferred over duplicating the [ShaderMaterial] when possible.

method.name: set_shader_variant
method.description: Sets the value of the provided shader [param variant]. This is like an enum uniform, but is static rather than being a uniform, causing it to change how the shader compiles. This sets the value by its numeric index, which can be acquired from [method get_shader_variant_index]. See also: [method set_shader_variant_by_name].

method.name: set_shader_variant_by_name
method.description: Sets the value of the provided shader [param variant]. This is like an enum uniform, but is static rather than being a uniform, causing it to change how the shader compiles. This sets the value by its name.

members.member: The [Shader] program used to render this material.
All shader features and variants that this shader will be compiled with.
